info.title: Queue OpenAPI for fal-ai/seedvr/upscale/image
info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the fal-ai/seedvr/upscale/image queue.

output_format.title: Output Format
output_format.description: The format of the output image.

upscale_mode.title: Upscale Mode
upscale_mode.description: The mode to use for the upscale. If 'target', the upscale factor will be calculated based on the target resolution. If 'factor', the upscale factor will be used directly.

noise_scale.title: Noise Scale
noise_scale.description: The noise scale to use for the generation process.

target_resolution.title: Target Resolution
target_resolution.description: The target resolution to upscale to when `upscale_mode` is `target`.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: The random seed used for the generation process.

upscale_factor.title: Upscale Factor
upscale_factor.description: Upscaling factor to be used. Will multiply the dimensions with this factor when `upscale_mode` is `factor`.

image_url.title: Image Url
image_url.description: The input image to be processed

enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker
enable_safety_checker.description: If set to true, the safety checker will be enabled.

sync_mode.title: Sync Mode
sync_mode.description: If `True`, the media will be returned as a data URI and the output data won't be available in the request history.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: The random seed used for the generation process.

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: The mime type of the file.

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.

file_size.title: File Size
file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.
